sources.evidence: Russian-language paper by Vasiliev, Kazakov, Korneev et al. on the 2001-2002 ACM ICPC semifinal (NEERC, St Petersburg), which names the Southern-Volga (Saratov State Univ.) group only as one of eight quarterfinal groups; it is not a site or results page of the Southern Subregional contest.
